note: Backlog for the Operational Knowledge Stream. IMPORTANT (Fresco): one question at a time, not a batch — each question spawns 5-10 unexpected insights, so depth beats breadth. Work Question → Discussion → Model Update → Next Question. Each answer becomes a verified engineering_rule / knowledge_model entity (source_type=operational_knowledge), classified (engineering_principle | production_strategy | operational_rule | decision_heuristic) and carrying a confidence_scope.

questions.question: Do the Identity/Process rules and the Identity Gate apply to finish coatings and other liquid systems, or are those genuinely different?
questions.why: Current verified scope is only B-4 + Dry Powder; everything else is explicitly NOT verified.
questions.unblocks: scope expansion of the whole knowledge model

questions.question: For each identity variable (PSD, cement type, aggregate type), what deviation triggers REJECT? Is there a measurable tolerance, or is it pass/fail vs the supplier standard?
questions.why: The Identity Gate's reject decision needs a boundary to be operational.

questions.question: What QUANTITATIVELY defines a fit Premix? Cellulose is checked as no-agglomeration/dry/free-flowing — is any of that measurable, or fully visual?
questions.why: Premix is a fixed component with no Batch ID; its fitness gate is currently qualitative only.

questions.question: For pH/viscosity/SG failures: how many Adjust→Retest cycles before a batch is rejected, and what is the adjustment mechanism (which additive moves which variable)?
questions.why: Manufacturing Response currently records the action but not its limit or lever.

questions.question: Which process variables (pH, viscosity, SG) actually predict product performance (adhesion, fire, durability), and which are independent QC only?
questions.why: Separates QC-only variables from performance-predictive ones — drives the coupling registry.

questions.question: What is the quantitative workability spec for dry mortars, and why ~every 15 batches for the full check (what risk does that cadence cover)?
questions.why: Dry-mortar QC has no pH/viscosity; workability is the gate but is currently unquantified.

questions.question: What qualifies a supplier/CoA as trusted in the first place, and is there any re-qualification trigger besides an observed failure?
questions.why: CoA is event-driven authority today; the entry criterion isn't captured.

questions.question: Which Engineering Playbook rules (ENG-001..009) do you expect to hold beyond dry powder, and which are dry-powder-specific?
questions.why: Lets us widen scope per-rule with your authority instead of guessing.

questions.question: When a Premix or PSD Design changes, how is that versioned relative to the formula — same formula id, or a new one?
questions.why: Formula ≠ Recipe (4 layers); we need to know which layer change creates a new formula identity.

intake: Each answer → add/extend an engineering_rule (config/engineering_playbook_v1.json) or a knowledge_model entity, tagged source=David, source_type=operational_knowledge, knowledge_class=<one of the 4>, validation_status=verified, and a confidence_scope {verified_for, not_verified_for, future_validation} exactly as David bounds it.
